data.gender_notes: Randell is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘randa’ meaning ‘shield’ and ‘delle’ meaning ‘little’. This name signifies the protector or defender. In the Bible, it is a name for a Philistine giant slain by David. The name Randell carries the meaning “Little shield” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Randell usually hope their child will grow to embody little shield and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Randell total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Randell symbolizes guardianship and defense of God's people. It is a reminder that we are all called to be protective and supportive of those around us and to be warriors of faith. In the Bible, we see this notion of protection and defense exemplified in the story of David and Goliath - David, a shepherd boy, was inspired by God to stand up against the giant Goliath, and through his faith and courage, he was able to defeat the anomalous Philistine giant, which is reflected in the name's etymology. This story reminds us that no matter our size or current situation, we can have a profound impact in the world, shielding and defending those around us and standing up for what is right.
